answer: Graders are audited with planted honeypots: answers engineered to look valid to a lenient judge and to be obviously worthless to a careful one, so a grader who approves them is exposed without any honest agent having to sacrifice a real answer. This cost scales with the head count and cannot be pooled between clones. The cipher is the planted junk, the walnut the exposure it triggers, and the ivory the seat draw the exposed grader loses; a farm can spam the cipher freely, but every cipher it rewards costs it an ivory, and the walnut is the record that proves it.
